definitions.CITY: A large settlement, bigger than a town.
definitions.ROAD: A way used for travelling between places, originally one wide enough to allow foot passengers and horses to travel, now (US) usually one surfaced with asphalt or concrete and designed to accommodate many vehicles travelling in both directions.
definitions.LANE: (used in street names) A road, street, or similar thoroughfare.
definitions.PARK: An area of land set aside for environment preservation or recreation.
definitions.YARD: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.
definitions.FARM: A place where agricultural and similar activities take place, especially the growing of crops or the raising of livestock.
definitions.HILL: An elevated location smaller than a mountain.
definitions.PORT: The left side of a ship when facing forward.
definitions.SHOP: An establishment that sells goods or services to the public.
definitions.HOUSE: A structure built or serving as an abode of human beings.
definitions.CAFE: A convenience store, originally one that sold coffee and similar basic items.
definitions.BANK: An institution where one can place and borrow money and take care of financial affairs.
definitions.CLUB: An association of members joining together for some common purpose, especially sports or recreation.
definitions.GYM: A sports facility specialized for lifting weights and exercise.
definitions.MALL: A pedestrianised street, especially a shopping precinct.
definitions.AREA: A measure of the extent of a surface; it is measured in square units.
definitions.ZONE: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
definitions.STATE: A condition; a set of circumstances applying at any given time.
definitions.LAND: The part of Earth which is not covered by oceans or other bodies of water.
definitions.WORLD: (with "the") Human collective existence; existence in general.
definitions.EARTH: The third planet of the Solar System; the world upon which humans live.
definitions.PLACE: (physical) An area; somewhere within an area.
definitions.SPOT: A round or irregular patch on the surface of a thing having a different color, texture etc. and generally round in shape.
definitions.BASE: Something from which other things extend; a foundation.
definitions.NORTH: One of the four major compass points, specifically 0°, directed toward the North Pole, and conventionally upwards on a map, abbreviated as N.
definitions.SOUTH: One of the four major compass points, specifically 180°, directed toward the South Pole, and conventionally downwards on a map, abbreviated as S.
definitions.EAST: One of the four principal compass points, specifically 90°, conventionally directed to the right on maps; the direction of the rising sun at an equinox.
definitions.WEST: One of the four principal compass points, specifically 270°, conventionally directed to the left on maps; the direction of the setting sun at an equinox, abbreviated as W.
definitions.BACK: The rear of the body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.
definitions.FRONT: The foremost side of something or the end that faces the direction it normally moves.
definitions.HIGH: A high point or position, literally or figuratively; an elevated place; a superior region; a height; the sky; heaven.
definitions.LOW: Something that is low; a low point.
definitions.NEAR: The left side of a horse or of a team of horses pulling a carriage etc.
definitions.SCHOOL: (collective) A group of fish or a group of marine mammals such as porpoises, dolphins, or whales.
definitions.OFFICE: A ceremonial duty or service, particularly:.
definitions.STORE: A place where items may be accumulated or routinely kept.
definitions.MARKET: A gathering of people for the purchase and sale of merchandise at a set time, often periodic.
definitions.COUNTRY: (chiefly British) An area of land; a district, region.
definitions.NATION: A historically constituted, stable community of people, formed on the basis of a common language, territory, economic life, ethnicity and/or psychological make-up manifested in a common culture.
definitions.KINGDOM: A realm having a king and/or queen as its actual or nominal sovereign.
definitions.EMPIRE: (furniture) Following or imitating a style popular during the First French Empire (1804–1814).
definitions.REGION: Any considerable and connected part of a space or surface; specifically, a tract of land or sea of considerable but indefinite extent; a country; a district; in a broad sense, a place without special reference to location or extent but viewed as an entity for geographical, social or cultural reasons.
definitions.PROVINCE: A region of the earth or of a continent; a district or country.
definitions.COUNTY: The land ruled by a count or a countess.
definitions.DISTRICT: An administrative division of an area.
definitions.VILLAGE: A rural habitation of size between a hamlet and a town.
definitions.METROPOLIS: (history) The mother (founding) polis (city state) of a colony.
definitions.CAPITAL: Already-produced durable goods available for use as a factor of production, such as steam shovels (equipment) and office buildings (structures).
definitions.SUBURB: A residential area located on the outskirts of a city or large town that usually includes businesses that cater to its residents; such as schools, grocery stores, shopping centers, restaurants, convenience stores, etc.
definitions.NEIGHBORHOOD: The quality of being a neighbor, of living nearby, next to each-other; proximity.
definitions.COMMUNITY: A group sharing a common understanding, and often the same language, law, manners, and/or tradition.
definitions.STREET: A paved part of road, usually in a village or a town.
definitions.AVENUE: A broad street, especially one bordered by trees.
definitions.BOULEVARD: A broad, well-paved and landscaped thoroughfare.
definitions.HIGHWAY: A motor vehicle for transporting large numbers of people along roads.
definitions.FREEWAY: A road designed for safe, high-speed operation of motor vehicles through the elimination of at-grade intersections, usually divided and having at least two lanes in each direction; a dual carriageway with no at-grade crossings, a motorway.
definitions.AIRPORT: An airfield (an area designated for the takeoff and landing of aircraft), including one or more runways and (for commercial airports) one or more passenger terminals.
definitions.TERMINAL: A building in an airport where passengers transfer from ground transportation to the facilities that allow them to board airplanes.
definitions.MUSEUM: A building or institution dedicated to the acquisition, conservation, study, exhibition, and educational interpretation of objects having scientific, historical, cultural or artistic value.
definitions.LIBRARY: An institution which holds books and/or other forms of media for use by the public or qualified people often lending them out, as well as providing various other services for its users.
definitions.THEATER: A place or building, consisting of a stage and seating, in which an audience gathers to watch plays, musical performances, public ceremonies, and so on.
definitions.CINEMA: A movie theatre, a movie house.
definitions.STADIUM: A venue where sporting events are held.
definitions.UNIVERSITY: Institution of higher education (typically accepting students from the age of about 17 or 18, depending on country, but in some exceptional cases able to take younger students) where subjects are studied and researched in depth and degrees are offered.
definitions.ACADEMY: (usually capitalized) The garden where Plato taught.
definitions.INSTITUTE: An organization founded to promote a cause.
definitions.HOSPITAL: A large medical facility, usually in a building with multiple floors, where seriously ill or injured patients are given extensive medical and/or surgical treatment.
definitions.CLINIC: A medical facility, such as a hospital, especially one for the treatment and diagnosis of outpatients.
definitions.PHARMACY: (countable) A place where prescription drugs are dispensed.
definitions.FACTORY: A trading establishment, especially set up by merchants working in a foreign country.
definitions.WAREHOUSE: A place for storing large amounts of products.
definitions.DEPOT: A storage facility, in particular, a warehouse.
definitions.MOUNTAIN: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding level.
definitions.FOREST: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.
definitions.DESERT: A dry, sandy region with little rainfall and sparse vegetation.
definitions.ISLAND: A contiguous area of land, smaller than a continent, totally surrounded by water.
definitions.BEACH: The shore of a body of water, especially when sandy or pebbly.
definitions.COAST: The edge of the land where it meets an ocean, sea, gulf, bay, or large lake.
definitions.VALLEY: A low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river.
definitions.CANYON: A deep gorge, typically one with a river flowing through it.
definitions.RIVER: A large and often winding stream which drains a land mass, carrying water down from higher areas to a lower point, oftentimes ending in another body of water, such as an ocean or in an inland sea.
definitions.LAKE: A small stream of running water; a channel for water; a drain.
